name: Row Yaniv
summary: A simultaneous-choice take on Yaniv: each round every player secretly chooses to call YANIV, draw blind or take from a public offer row, and sheds a card (with any matches). The lowest hand at showdown avoids penalty, and the lowest penalty total wins.

player.meaning: Card value in slot 1 (0-10), or -1 if empty
Card value in slot 2 (0-10), or -1 if empty
Card value in slot 3 (0-10), or -1 if empty
H: the sum of the non-empty slots
Penalty total (the score; lower is better)
This round's action (YANIV, DRAW or TAKE) after invalid-YANIV and lost-TAKE conversions
Chosen offer-row position, used only for TAKE
Effective shed slot (1-3), corrected to the lowest non-empty slot if the chosen one is empty
Made a valid YANIV this round
Card values shed this round, in slot order
H revealed at the most recent showdown

game.meaning: Seat that resolves first in TAKE and DRAW
When true, a fresh hand is shuffled and dealt at the start of the round
Card values in the draw pile; its order is hidden
Number of cards in the draw pile
Ordered public offer row of card values
Every card that has left play this hand
Offer-row positions already taken this round
At least one valid YANIV was made this round
M: the lowest H among valid callers
N: the lowest H among non-callers (99 if everyone called)
The lowest H overall, used when there is no valid caller
The highest penalty total, kept beside the scores for the end check

setup: Every player's penalty is set to 0 and all slots c1, c2 and c3 are set to -1 (empty).
round = 1, priority_seat = 1, new_hand = true, and offer_row and dead_pile are empty.

round.effect: When new_hand is true: draw_pile is set to the full 54-card list [0,0, four each of 1-9, sixteen 10s]; all slots are set to -1; dead_pile is emptied; in seat order, each player draws 3 cards at random from draw_pile into c1, c2 and c3 (removed from draw_pile); one more random card from draw_pile becomes offer_row = [that card]; new_hand = false. Then hand_total, card_count and draw_pile_size are recomputed.
Each player privately sees their own c1, c2, c3 and hand_total.
Announce offer_row with positions and values, dead_pile, draw_pile_size, priority_seat and every player's card_count.
Reset for the round: is_caller = false, shed_values = [], claimed = [], any_valid_yaniv = false, showdown = false.
Stored privately in action; no answer is shown until all are in.

round.answer: a whole number from 1 to the length of offer_row
round.effect: Stored privately in take_pos (used only for TAKE).
Stored in shed_slot; if that slot is -1, shed_slot is set to the lowest-numbered non-empty slot.
YANIV check: for each player with action = YANIV, if hand_total <= 10 then is_caller = true, otherwise action = DRAW and the YANIV is announced as invalid. any_valid_yaniv = (count of is_caller > 0).

SHED, when any_valid_yaniv is false: each player appends the value in their shed slot to shed_values, then for each of their other slots, in slot order, holding that same value, appends it and sets that slot to -1. The shed slot is set to -1. Every player's shed_values is announced.

round.who: each player in turn, starting at priority_seat and wrapping
round.effect: TAKE, when any_valid_yaniv is false: for each player with action = TAKE in that order, if take_pos is not in claimed, the shed slot is set to offer_row[take_pos], take_pos is appended to claimed, and the take is announced; otherwise action = DRAW.

round.who: each player in turn, starting at priority_seat and wrapping
round.effect: DRAW, when any_valid_yaniv is false: for each player with action = DRAW in that order, one random card is removed from draw_pile and placed in the shed slot, told only to that player; draw_pile_size decreases by 1.

ROW UPDATE, when any_valid_yaniv is false: offer_row cards at positions not in claimed are appended to dead_pile; offer_row = the concatenation of shed_values from seat 1 upward. hand_total and card_count are recomputed, and every card_count and draw_pile_size is announced.
Each player privately sees their updated slots and hand_total.

showdown = any_valid_yaniv OR draw_pile_size < number of players OR round = 24. When showdown is true: last_hand_total = hand_total for every player (all hands revealed); min_caller_h = the lowest hand_total among is_caller players (99 if none); min_noncaller_h = the lowest among the others (99 if none); min_h = the lowest hand_total overall.

SCORING, when showdown is true. With any_valid_yaniv: a caller adds 0 if hand_total = min_caller_h and min_caller_h < min_noncaller_h, otherwise adds hand_total + 20; a non-caller adds 0 if hand_total <= min_caller_h, otherwise adds hand_total. Without any_valid_yaniv: a player adds 0 if hand_total = min_h, otherwise adds hand_total. Then max_penalty = the highest penalty, new_hand = true, and all hands and penalty totals are announced.
priority_seat = (priority_seat mod number of players) + 1; round increases by 1.
End the game if (showdown is true and max_penalty >= 50) or round > 24; otherwise continue.

ending.decided_by: Each player's standing is their penalty total; the lowest penalty wins, and players tied for the lowest share the win (a draw among them).

rules.text: When a new hand starts, the draw pile is the 54 values (two 0s, four each of 1-9, sixteen 10s), each player receives 3 random cards into c1, c2 and c3, and 1 more card becomes the offer row, leaving 54 - 3*players - 1 cards in the draw pile.
When a new hand starts, the dead pile is emptied and the new-hand flag is switched off.
A player's hand total H is the sum of their non-empty slots (an empty slot counts as nothing).
When a player calls YANIV with H <= 10, the call is valid; with H = 11 or more it is announced as invalid and the player is treated as DRAW.
When at least one valid YANIV is made, no card moves that round and a showdown follows.
When a player sheds, the card in their shed slot and every other slot of theirs with the same value are removed, so a pair sheds 2 cards and a triple sheds 3.
When the chosen shed slot is empty, the lowest-numbered non-empty slot is shed instead.
When two TAKE players choose the same position, the one earlier in seat order from the priority seat gets the card, and the other becomes DRAW.
A taken or drawn card is placed in the player's shed slot; extra slots emptied by a pair or triple stay empty for the rest of the hand.
A drawn card's value is told only to the drawing player, and the draw pile size drops by 1 per draw.
After the take step, untaken offer-row cards go to the dead pile, and the new offer row is all shed cards in seat order from seat 1, in slot order within each player.
A showdown happens when a valid YANIV was made, when the draw pile holds fewer cards than there are players after the row update, or in round 24.
With valid callers, a caller whose H equals M (the lowest caller H) scores 0 when M < N (the lowest non-caller H, or 99 if all called); otherwise the caller scores H + 20.
With valid callers, a non-caller scores 0 when their H <= M; otherwise they score H.
In a showdown with no valid caller, every player with the lowest H scores 0 and the others score their H.
After every showdown, scores are added to penalty totals, all hands are revealed, and the next round starts a fresh hand.
Every round the priority seat moves to the next seat, wrapping from the last seat to seat 1.
The match ends after a showdown that leaves some penalty total at 50 or more, or after round 24.
The player with the lowest penalty total wins, and players tied for the lowest share the win.

offers.question: action
offers.options: YANIV, DRAW, TAKE (the offer row always holds at least one card)

offers.question: take position
offers.options: a whole number from 1 to the current length of offer_row

offers.question: shed slot
offers.options: 1, 2, 3 (an empty slot is replaced by the lowest non-empty slot, as the rules allow)

choices.why: The designer suggested 3, which is kept. The minimum is 2 because two players still race to a low hand, contest the row and time YANIV against Asaf. The maximum is 4 because each hand uses 3 cards per player plus the row, and more seats make take collisions and draws so frequent that one player's choice matters little.
A Joker is worth 0, so 0 cannot also mean empty.
The rules say there is no discussion phase.
Thoughtful players track the dead pile and offer row to count cards, set up pairs to shed several cards at once, avoid contested row positions, and time YANIV to avoid being undercut (Asaf).

choices.what: The end check uses max_penalty after a showdown
choices.why: This keeps the 50-point condition arithmetic on a table attribute.

simplifications.what: The three simultaneous answers are three consecutive polls
simplifications.why: A question takes one answer. Answers are stored privately and never shown between polls, so the choices stay simultaneous.

simplifications.what: Shuffling and drawing from the top are modelled as random draws from the draw_pile list
simplifications.why: Drawing at random from an unordered hidden list is equivalent to drawing the top card of a shuffled pile.

simplifications.what: Skipping steps 6-9 after a valid YANIV is done with a per-step condition (any_valid_yaniv is false)
simplifications.why: The step list is flat, but single steps can carry arithmetic conditions.
